STATUS: All live manuscript values come from uninterrupted state-preserved runs and are reported on the 20 fresh validation realizations (seeds 500-519). The chunk-restarted run is excluded from all archives and results. Values under 'superseded_single_draw_operating' come from a single screening realization, are retained for traceability only, and MUST be excluded from manuscript generation.
selection_rule: least-cost nondominated design with q95(LPSP) <= 0.1% estimated on 8 common screening realizations

screening_vs_validation.supporting_analyses: resampling of 8-draw subsets (T27) and paired low-loss design comparison (T28) are retained as context
screening_vs_validation.mechanism: OPEN QUESTION. Sampling variability, design selection, and design-specific stochastic response may all contribute. The available samples are too small to identify a unique cause; no mechanistic claim is made.
screening_vs_validation.reportable_conclusion: A service-loss statistic computed on the realizations used to select a design is not an independent performance estimate and requires validation on separate realizations.

ablation.caveat: F3 replicated across two seeds; F1 and F2 executed once under the final treatment

operating.basis: mean over the 20 fresh validation realizations (seeds 500-519), identical to the LCOH, service-loss and hydrogen-balance basis

lcoh_decomposition_basis: mean of components across the 20 fresh validation draws; sums exactly to the 20-draw mean LCOH of 11.7184

hydrogen_balance_kg_per_yr.basis: measured, mean of 20 fresh validation draws

storage_behaviour.basis: logged hourly trajectories, 2020-2022 chronology, 20 fresh demand realizations (seeds 500-519), same basis as the LCOH and service-loss validation
storage_behaviour.floor_metric_status: SECONDARY ONLY. High draw-to-draw variability; not a system property.
storage_behaviour.threshold_caveat: 25% is a descriptive threshold; duration metrics vary 13.8-43.6 days across 15-40% thresholds (T24)

production_cap_verification.statement: P_AWE/SEC_AWE + P_PEM/SEC_PEM <= q_max(t) verified hourly after technology allocation
production_cap_verification.note: the pre-allocation power bound uses SEC_AWE (the smaller SEC) and is therefore conservative; this check confirms the post-allocation constraint directly rather than relying on that argument

superseded_single_draw_operating.basis: ONE screening realization; retained only for traceability, not for manuscript use
